assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these neurological and vestibular symptoms.
The service was documented in the clinical indication note.
The diagnosis codes G45.9 and R42 support the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure.
The payer letter states that the claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification.
The clinical documentation establishes the medical necessity of the service, justifying the appeal for review and payment.
